machine: dgbox-ai-server (192.168.2.185), Minisforum MS-01 + Spring V100 SXM2 4-GPU carrier board
purpose: capability and bandwidth of the P2P (NVLink) route, to support enabling it in the engine

peer_access_cost_mib.method: cudaMemGetInfo delta around cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess, before any allocation
peer_access_cost_mib.why_it_matters: free VRAM with the model loaded is 256 MiB (CUDA3), 404 MiB (CUDA0), 998 MiB (CUDA1), 1350 MiB (CUDA2)

during_prefill_31375_tokens.load_confirmed_by: nvidia-smi dmon -s t captured 0-5.5 GB/s per card in the same seconds

peer_copy_bandwidth.other_pairs: not measurable with the model loaded: a context plus a buffer needs ~400 MiB free, five pairs have less
peer_copy_bandwidth.interpretation: 38.4 GB/s is unreachable over this PCIe fabric (per-card Gen3 x8 = 7.9 GB/s, one shared x8 uplink) and is consistent with two bonded NVLink 2 links (2 x 25.781 GB/s = 51.6 GB/s theoretical, 74% achieved); so it is indirect evidence that an enabled P2P route really uses NVLink on this board

host_path_for_comparison.uplink: one Gen3 x8 shared by four cards (4:1 oversubscription), ~2 GB/s per card effective

prompt_path_volumes_for_reference.note: RX is 5-8x TX, so the dominant flow is host->card; which route those bytes take is not derivable from PCIe counters
